name: go-build-release
description: > Build and release Go binaries that are reproducible and verifiable: version stamping, -trimpath builds, cross-compilation, GoReleaser, checksums, SBOMs, cosign signing, build provenance attestations, and container images with ko or a multi-stage Dockerfile. Use when: "release a Go binary", "set up GoReleaser", "cross-compile", "reproducible build", "sign the release", "generate an SBOM", "build provenance", "publish a container image", "version command shows (devel)". Not for: test and lint pi
author: eduardo-sl
